Official Naming Recommendations

The Forge & Workshop Angle

1. SlingerForge

Evokes heavy industrial metallurgy and toolcraft. Raw scraped web specifications are forged into pristine, validated eBay bulk upload catalog entries.

The High-Velocity Dyno Angle

2. DynoSlinger

High-horsepower automotive dynamometer tuning. Pulling maximum horsepower, specs, and interchange compatibility out of unstructured catalog pages.

The Precision Measurement Angle

3. ApexCaliper

Automotive dial calipers measuring fitment tolerances to the exact thousandth of an inch (.001"). Reflects 30.7M record DuckDB ePID precision.

The Heritage NOS Angle

4. ChronoSpec NOS

Vintage time-capsule discovery. Finding forgotten warehouse inventory and instantly decoding historical fitment, interchange, and original MPNs.

The Hardware & Torque Angle

5. GearBolt

Short, punchy, memorable, and muscular. Pure mechanical nuts-and-bolts engineering ready to bolt directly onto your workflow.

The Direct Enterprise Angle

6. PartSlinger Pro Spec

Retains the core established brand name "PartSlinger", adding the professional specification badge for instant brand continuity.
